basics.name: Mantri Aditya
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer (Automation) with a Master of Science in Engineering Science and 2+ years of experience, seeking full-time roles focused on on-site Industrial Automation, Software Systems and Robotics Engineering.

work.summary: Analyzed supply chain data and supported logistics platform improvements using SQL, Python, and SAP WM.
highlights: Utilized Python scripts and Postman to automate diagnostic testing and data validation on applications.
Developed scalable RESTful APIs hosted on Azure to streamline data workflows and system integration.
Optimized backend data pipelines using Python, improving data retrieval speeds and overall software reliability.

work.summary: Applied Six Sigma and Lean tools to drive process improvement across automated distribution workflows.
highlights: Supervised a 4-member technical support team and managed on-site hardware maintenance for diversion system PLCs and RTP robot fleets, boosting equipment utilization across live warehouse operations.
Spearheaded a team of 3 to deploy cleaning brush retrofits on RTP bots and performed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on electromechanical defects, driving a 40% increase in expedited outbound shipments.
Coordinated site-level safety compliance, including arc flash protocols and LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) procedures, to execute hardware tie-ins, passing all safety audits and stress tests.
Modified mechanical components using Creo Parametric, eliminating recurring malfunctions to reduce downtime.

work.summary: Conducted process capability studies and flow mapping to support supply chain and inventory planning.
highlights: Spearheaded a Process Capability study using SPC charts to ensure reliable inputs for supply planning models.
Created detailed Flow Charts to map current vs. future state inspection processes and identify bottlenecks.

awards.title: Six Sigma Green Belt
awards.awarder: The Council for Six Sigma Certification
awards.summary: Demonstrated proficiency in DMAIC methodology, statistical process control, and Lean tools including RCA, Pareto Analysis, and Fishbone diagrams. Certified to lead process improvement initiatives that reduce operational waste and enhance supply chain efficiency.
